label: NATIONAL CEMETERY ADMINISTRATION
source_document: PL 105-368 §403 (Veterans Programs Enhancement Act of 1998), 112 Stat. 3337–3339; redesignation of National Cemetery System as National Cemetery Administration with concurrent redesignation of the Director as Under Secretary of Veterans Affairs for Memorial Affairs and elevation from Executive Schedule Level IV (5 USC §5315) to Level III (5 USC §5314). The Director was already PAS under PL 100-527 §3(d) so appointment-authority chain is unchanged. Non-rename provisions are personnel-policy (Rule 6 categories 1 and 4): compensation adjustment and position-title rebranding. Function, type, and placement of the National Cemetery Administration within DVA are unchanged. Coded Nominal under Rule 6

label: VETERANS HEALTH ADMINISTRATION
source_document: PL 102-40 §2 (Department of Veterans Affairs Health-Care Personnel Act of 1991), 105 Stat. 187; redesignation of Veterans Health Services and Research Administration as Veterans Health Administration. Title I of the act establishes special-pay authorities for VHA physicians and dentists (Rule 6 personnel-policy category 1); Title II authorizes collective bargaining for VHA health-care employees (category 2). Function (healthcare delivery to veterans), type, and placement of VHA within DVA are unchanged. Coded Nominal under Rule 6
